guards.what: G2 (DORMANT, but the fix must not reproduce it): C# UPGRADES A CLONE -- `RunState.CloneCard(card)` then `CardCmd.Upgrade(card2)` then `cardReward.ModifyCard(card2, this)` (LavaLamp.cs:83-85) -- and the sim has no clone helper
guards.issue: PROMPT.md bug class 17. CardModel.CreateClone is ClonePreservingMutability (CardModel.cs:2168-2179) and carries the card's enchantment, affliction, keyword edits and local energy-cost modifiers as well as its upgrade level; .superpowers/sdd/content-relic-sweeps.md sweep E establishes by execution that every sim rebuild drops all but the upgrade level, and audit/records/relic/burning_sticks.json G3 records the mechanism as LIVE at its own site. The reason C# clones at all here is that a CardCreationResult keeps the ORIGINAL alongside the modified card, so the un-upgraded option survives for the run-history screen. DORMANT AT THIS SITE for a reason that is specific and worth stating: the cards being cloned are freshly generated reward options that carry no per-instance state yet -- create_reward_cards makes them with make_card and, apart from the upgrade roll, nothing has touched them -- EXCEPT that the LATE pass runs after relic/glitter and relic/silken_tress may already have enchanted them, in which case C#'s clone keeps the enchantment and a sim rebuild would drop it. So the fix must mutate the option in place (as relics/silver_crucible.py:28-34 and relics/glitter.py:16-21 do) rather than copy it. Filed so that closing G1 does not open a class-17 instance. Rule 7: src/Core/Models/CardModel.cs, rewards.py, relics/glitter.py, relics/silken_tress.py and relics/silver_crucible.py are not hashed by this record.

guards.what: N1: `card.IsUpgradable` guards the Upgrade (LavaLamp.cs:81) -- PROMPT.md bug class 14
guards.rationale: C# checks IsUpgradable (`CurrentUpgradeLevel < MaxUpgradeLevel`, CardModel.cs:785-789) BEFORE cloning and upgrading, so it never marks a curse or status as upgraded. Recorded because class 14 has fired twice already (astrolabe G1, bone_tea) and the sim's Card.upgrade() (cards/base.py:146-147) is a bare increment: a G1 fix MUST reproduce this guard, and `Card.is_upgradable` (cards/base.py:168-170) is the member to use. Nothing to compare today -- the port has no call -- so this entry is a pre-emptive pin rather than a divergence. Rule 7: src/Core/Models/CardModel.cs and cards/base.py are not hashed by this record.

guards.rationale: PROMPT.md bug class 15 (paired hooks rarely carry the same guard set) checked and CLEARED for this unit: the two behavioural hooks carry the SAME room guard, and the reward hook adds only the multiplayer owner comparison, which the contract puts in maps_to rather than treating as a divergence. The room guard confines the relic to combat card rewards -- it must not upgrade an event's or a shop's card options -- and since the sim's modify_card_reward_options is reached from create_reward_cards for BOTH combat rewards and Lead Paperweight's out-of-combat offer (relics/lead_paperweight.py:24-28), a G1 fix that omits the room check would wrongly upgrade the latter. Recorded as the concrete trap in the fix. Rule 7: relics/lead_paperweight.py and rewards.py are not hashed by this record.
